meta.name: BBC Home & Garden
meta.description:
Take a trip across the pond with the one channel bringing you the best in British home remodeling and garden cultivation.

Shows: George Clarke's Old House New Home, Around the World in 80 Gardens, Buckingham Palace with Alexander Armstrong, World's Weirdest Homes, Art, Passion and Power: The Story of the Royal Collection
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
